name: get_device_family
description: Returns a device's real protocol family: insteon, z-wave, zigbee, matter, plugin, or unknown. Never infer a device's family from its name, address/id, icon, or a naming convention you believe you've noticed -- always call this instead. Required before any protocol-specific diagnostics or action (e.g. which `protocol` value to pass to `pair_device`/`node_op` for this device). Cheap and side-effect-free -- call it any time this fact is needed, not just while troubleshooting.

device_id.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown for it in DEVICE DATABASE.
